Name: Kenneth's Massive Farm - Ultra Wide
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]The widest farm I made - you can barely see the end.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]320x65 = 20,800 tiles, 4x vanilla. Same height, but super stretched sideways. This is huge, honestly it's a mega field. Perfect if you want a giant single field for 1000+ crops, or a massive ranch side-by-side.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Vanilla is only 80x65 (5,200 tiles), so this is 4x bigger. All tillable.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Two versions inside:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Standard: Replaces normal farm for existing saves.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Additional Farms: Shows as custom farm when starting new game, has Day 1 restoration mail because of that old furniture bug - now fixed and gives items back.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Install: SMAPI + Content Patcher -> Mods. Works with 1.6 and Android.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This one is Kenneth's Massive Farm - Ultra Wide.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Note: Inventory full at start? Place the Chest first, then store extra furniture inside. The Chest is there to help you.[/b][/size]

Downloads.Description: Old save? Use this one. Replaces vanilla Standard farm.
